# Mission: Morse Code

## Why
Hear Morse as sound patterns rather than decoding dots and dashes from a chart.

## Success looks like
- Recognise all 26 letters and 10 digits by ear at 20 WPM character speed.
- Copy short random groups at 20 WPM with at least 90% accuracy.

## Constraints
- 10 to 15 minutes of practice on most days.
